GREENKO INTEGRATED MANAGEMENT SYSTEM

                                                                    WORK INSTRUCTION FOR LEAKAGE IN THE HUB

    1.   PURPOSE

         This document describes the standard operating procedure for Leakage in the HUB

    2.   SCOPE

         This document applies to Gamesa model in G97 & G114.

    3.   RESPONSIBILITY

         Authorised person only

    4.   SPARES, CONSUMABLES, TOOLS & TACKLES.
         Tools:   1. Multimeter - 1 No,
                  2. Spanner set - 1 set,
                  3. Screw driver & Voltage tester - 1 No each,
                  4. Craft work box (small) - 1 No.
         Spares & Consumables:
              1. Hub leak sensor.
              2. Hub leak sensor Cable.
    5.   DOCUMENTS & RECORDS

        Title                                                  Form No.
     Work permit

   Work at height       F-CO-EHS-13-08

Electrical isolation    F-CO-EHS-13-04

     Check list       CL- Wind-SG-EM-211

    6.   Safety Requirements:
        1.    Basic PPE's - Safety Shoe, Safety Helmet, Hand Gloves, safety harness etc.
        2.    Read turbine safety manual before carrying out any work in the turbine
        3.    Always complete safety documentation part - work permit etc.
        4.    Risk assessments and HIRA to be cross checked for the Job activity.
        5.    690 V/ 230 V will be available on control panel. Be careful.
    7.   ERROR CRITERIA

         This alarm is trigger when More than 3 seconds without detecting the sensor signal of leaks in the
         HUB.

    8.   PROCEDURE
            1    Check for any Physical Oil leakage in hub.
            2    Check the Hub leak sensor.
            3    Check the hub leak contactor connections.
            4    Check the DI module for any malfunction.
            5    Replace the failure component.





    WI-WIND-SG-EM-212    I1. R0/01.07.2019                     Page 1 of 1
                      INTERNAL
